task: Find an additional source-defined Bcl-w peptide background with confidently supported gain and loss single-substitution directions in a matched direct Kd assay; audit comparability before adding any pair.
primary_scope: Citation-neighbourhood of Foight 2014 plus targeted searches for Bcl-w BH3 peptide point mutations; do not claim an exhaustive literature survey.
fixed_constraints: A pair must share exact receptor construct, assay, peptide length and terminal chemistry; affinity must be Kd with interpretable uncertainty and repeat structure.
Retain source-defined parent-to-mutant direction. Never reverse a loss edge to manufacture a gain or count both directions of one measurement pair.
Do not pool raw affinities across receptor, assay, construct, peptide chemistry or unverified paper batches.
SPOT intensity, display enrichment, IC50, Ki, functional activity and protein/receptor mutations are separate evidence types; not direct peptide-mutation Kd labels.
Existing Foight 2014 Bcl-w audit has 7 source-defined pairs, 2 gain point candidates and 5 loss point candidates, with formal v2 labels still unreleased.

Existing parent backgrounds are Bim, Bim_A2eT, A12 and B3; gain candidates occur only in Bim_A2eT. The current shortfall is qualifying pair count, gain count and distribution across backgrounds, not the mere existence of a second background.
Source selection is label-aware and publicly exposed; no blind-test claim.
stop: Complete the bounded source table and a GO/HOLD decision. If no usable new matched pair is supported, report precisely which fields fail and stop this Bcl-w expansion round without changing frozen criteria.
